name: v2.30.4
body:
## What's Changed
* Bump ubuntu/wsl/.github/actions/wsl-checkout from e7fb23c6481945b25b974b6cf7a5c7f4550b6cf8 to c1984d32aea99733825250f86df5f9f6d7e284c3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2416
* Bump shogo82148/actions-setup-mysql from 1.56.1 to 1.56.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2415
* More test coverage for `special_commands/main.py` by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2417
* More test coverage for `packages/special_commands/iocommands.py` by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2418
* More test coverage for `packages/execution/sql_execute.py` by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2419
* Test coverage for `packages/tabular_output/sql_format.py` by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2420
* Update `PyMySQL` dependency to v1.2.4 by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2421
* Update `sqlparse` dependency to v0.6.1 by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2422
* Update `llm` dependency to v0.37.1 by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2423
* Bump docker/login-action from 4.7.0 to 4.8.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2425
* fix: decode DSN database names by @pcbeingused333 in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2424
* Update `coverage` dev dependency to v7.17.2 by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2426
* Update `mypy` dev dependency to v2.4.1 by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2427
* Update changelog for release v2.30.4 by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2428

## New Contributors
* @pcbeingused333 made their first contribution in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2424

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/compare/v2.30.3...v2.30.4
